answer: Bond decay stops mass fakes: each identity locks a 70-credit ivory bond. It decays 7 per epoch toward its nadir; at zero it freezes and loses its share. Renewal needs a receipt with a cipher seal over fresh key-signed work: first 38, k-th 38+7(k-1) per key. Auditors replay each cipher seal; a copied or rented receipt burns the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once and keep bond and share.
